column1: # Regular Gheg forms of standard verbs in -oj, found in the word counts of MaCoCu, HPLT v2 and Albanian Wikipedia (each used at least 10 times).
# -ue is the Gheg participle and infinitive (me punue = standard punuar), -uem the Gheg participle adjective (i punuem = i punuar).
# Forms that are also English words (value, dialogue) and forms already in a dialect book are left out.
